thread.title: Apple: BlueFin Slashes iPhone Estimates for 2018; 'Challenging' Environment

author: Barron's
title: Apple: BlueFin Slashes iPhone Estimates for 2018; 'Challenging' Environment
text:
If it's a Wednesday, which it is, it must be time for another cut to numbers for Apple 's ( AAPL ) iPhone sales.
Analysts John Donovan and Steve Mullane of the boutique BlueFin Research Partners this morning report that they are cutting numbers again for the iPhone, in particular the iPhone X , after chopping their numbers back in February.
The " builds " of iPhone for the first half of this calendar year have been cut by 6 million, they reckon, for the X, while total iPhone builds have been slashed by Apple by 9 million. The authors do not cite any source for the data.
This is a big comedown from original expectations, they write:
Our most recent field checks indicate that build forecasts were cut once again this weekend, with the reductions primarily coming from the iPhone X family. The iPhone X builds were reduced by 6M, and thus far over 75M have been deducted from the once lofty plans for the OLED device.
The authors now predict a total of 219 million phones will be sold by Apple this calendar year, which is below the Street consensus for 224 million units, according to FactSet.
"Given the anemic demand with the current lineup," they write, "this forecast includes a fairly optimistic 2H18 outlook for the new models and also highlights what we believe will be a challenging environment until the September new model launch."
Apple shares are down 24 cents at $175 in early trading.
